title: Egg fried rice with veg
steps: Use cold cooked rice, ideally from the day before: fresh rice turns mushy. If you have to cook it now, spread it on a plate to cool for 10 minutes.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat half the oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat, scramble the eggs until just set, then tip them onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the frozen vegetables, and stir-fry for 3 minutes until hot.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps, until it is steaming hot all the way through.
Add a splash of soy sauce, return the egg, toss together and serve.
